tools.name: oruk_transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe prerecorded English audio to text with time-ordered segments and word timings. Use this when only the words matter. tools.name: oruk_list_models
tools.description: List oruk’s speech models with lifecycle and per-task pricing (USD per audio minute), the five API tasks, the 15 emotion and 16 speaking-style labels, and audio limits. No API key required. Use this to choose a model, estimate cost before analyzing long audio, or see which labels exist.
